application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.title: loss of containment at TX-7001 during routine operation

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage.

defences.finding: Control ISOLATION_HANDBACK_CONTROL: the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as a task or environmental condition.

recommendations: Restore the controlled removal of isolation and return to service on TX-7001 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in applying and verifying an isolation, specifically applying locks, tags and personal danger tags. TX-7001 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during routine operation while the controlled removal of isolation and return to service had been bypassed. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 19 September 2008 an incident occurred on TX-7001 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during routine operation, releasing thermal energy held as hot surface.
